notes: 424B2 prospectus supplement for a rights offering by The Gabelli Equity Trust Inc. (NYSE: GAB), a closed-end fund; base prospectus dated December 23, 2020 is included in the excerpt. All five part files read in full. Subscription price is a fixed $5.50 per share, so price_reference fixed and price_pct null. The filing states NAV per share of $6.87 as of May 28, 2021; no percent of NAV is stated, so price_pct is not computed and stays null. Expiration July 14, 2021 is the latest date stated, subject to the extension language. Offering expenses of about $600,000 and the rights agent fee are not schema fields and are not recorded.
